cost_scope: Saved uncached refinement cost only; excludes common D46 upstream cost. Two-pass latency is max of sequential call durations, a hypothetical parallel estimate, not measured serving latency.
interpretation: Nine declared cached variants, eight alternatives to the stronger reference. Post-hoc exploratory selection; paired intervals are unadjusted and not independent confirmation. Pass2 is diagnostic, not permission to choose the better pass per query.
